# netbox_rack_types (Data Source)

Lists rack_type objects matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_rack_types" "test" {
  limit = 10
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes Set) Query filters, sent as API list parameters. Supported names: id, id__empty, id__gt, id__gte, id__lt, id__lte, id__n, manufacturer_id, manufacturer_id__n, model, model__empty, model__ic, model__ie, model__iew, model__iregex, model__isw, model__n, model__nic, model__nie, model__niew, model__nisw, model__regex, owner_id, owner_id__n, slug, slug__empty, slug__ic, slug__ie, slug__iew, slug__iregex, slug__isw, slug__n, slug__nic, slug__nie, slug__niew, slug__nisw, slug__regex, tag, tag__any, tag__n. Repeating a name sends that parameter once per value. Custom fields filter as cf_<field name>, e.g. cf_tier, with the field's own filter logic: loose is a case-insensitive substring match, exact an exact match. NetBox ignores names it has no custom field for, and such an entry does not narrow the result. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of objects to return from the API lookup. Defaults to 1000.

### Read-Only

- `rack_types` (Attributes List) The matching rack_types. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rack_types))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the query filter (the API list parameter).
- `value` (String) Value to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--rack_types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rack_types`

Read-Only:

- `comments` (String)
- `created` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `desc_units` (Boolean) Units are numbered top-to-bottom.
- `description` (String)
- `form_factor` (String) Rack form factor. One of: 2-post-frame, 4-post-frame, 4-post-cabinet, wall-frame, wall-frame-vertical, wall-cabinet, wall-cabinet-vertical.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `manufacturer_id` (Number) Id of the manufacturer.
- `max_weight` (Number) Maximum load capacity (requires weight_unit).
- `model` (String)
- `mounting_depth` (Number) Maximum depth of a mounted device, in millimetres.
- `mounting_depth_mm` (Number, Deprecated) Deprecated alias of mounting_depth.
- `outer_depth` (Number) Outer depth (requires outer_unit).
- `outer_height` (Number) Outer height (requires outer_unit).
- `outer_unit` (String) Unit of the outer dimensions. One of: mm, in.
- `outer_width` (Number) Outer width (requires outer_unit).
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `rack_count` (Number) Number of racks of the rack type.
- `slug` (String) URL-friendly unique shorthand; derived from model when not set.
- `starting_unit` (Number) Lowest unit number.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `u_height` (Number) Height in rack units.
- `url` (String)
- `weight` (Number) Weight of the rack (requires weight_unit).
- `weight_unit` (String) Unit of weight and max_weight. One of: kg, g, lb, oz.
- `width` (Number) Rail-to-rail width in inches. One of: 10, 19, 21, 23.
